chunks.subject: AP Research
chunks.title: Academic Paper exemplar — Sample B, 5/5
chunks.content: Sample B scored 5/5 (Rich Analysis of a New Understanding Addressing a Gap in the Research Base). Topic: beauty standards in advertising, examined through an influential beauty lens. The topic of inquiry is focused on narrow, explicit parameters; the method is well aligned; and the analysis produces a rich, well-supported new understanding that addresses a gap in the research base. Full-credit model paper — illustrates that a tightly scoped inquiry plus rich analysis reaches the top band.
